title: PX Compact Semantic Address Record
description: A compact, byte-addressable alias for a canonical entity, formatted Subject.Object.SemanticRole.Kind. Each of the four segments is a uint8 in the reserved-excluded range 1..254, and each is ALLOCATED FROM THE FROZEN CONTROLLED VOCABULARY in registry/semantic_address_vocabulary.json rather than derived from a digest, so the number carries the concept it names. The alias is a bound reference, not identity: entity_id remains the canonical authority, and an alias that cannot be resolved is stale rather than authoritative. A tombstoned address is retired permanently and is never reissued, including to its former entity, so no segment ever changes meaning over the life of the registry.

alias.description: Subject.Object.SemanticRole.Kind as 4 packed bytes, plus the allocation generation.

entity_id.description: The canonical entity this alias resolves to.

address.description: The four segments. 0 and 255 are reserved in every segment and must never appear as a live value.

generation.description: Bound to the semantic generation that issued the address. It distinguishes a reissue under new semantics from the retired alias of the same address; it does NOT authorise recycling, because tombstoned addresses are never reissued.

concepts.description: The declared semantic concepts this address was allocated from. Present so a reader can confirm the segments mean what the issuer claimed.

enum: allocated by disambiguation within the declared semantic base
allocation.description: Whether this address is the exact address its declared concepts imply, or a sibling within the same semantic base.

reservedValues.description: 0 denotes an unallocated or invalid slot; 255 denotes a tombstone. Both are forbidden as live segment values in every segment.

semanticAllocation.description: Segments are vocabulary numbers from registry/semantic_address_vocabulary.json, not digest bytes. A number outside the published vocabulary carries no reviewed meaning and is refused at allocation time; 0 and 255 stay reserved and the live segment range remains 1..254.
semanticAllocation.const: segments are frozen-vocabulary numbers, never digest bytes

noReuse.description: A tombstoned address is retired permanently. It is never reissued to another entity or returned to its former entity, because recycling would make a segment a different concept at a later time without any error at reissue.
